## Changes: * #4861: Sessions - add init repository action * #4862: Background - maintain repository path for folder session * #4863: nes: logs: include filter names when filtered * #4823: NES: tweak cursor placement for xtab call after cursor prediction * #4860: refactor(CopilotCLI): streamline chat history retrieval and clean up unused imports * #4858: Sessions - discard changes action should only be shown if there is a git repository * #4859: Update Changelog.mdto link to main release notes * #4857: Background - store repository folder information for workspace sessions * #4829: Background - include repositoryPath for folder sessions * #4855: Enhance Copilot CLI session handling with performance logging and improved session management
See More * #4850: feat(otel): add telemetry for OTel feature adoption tracking * #4848: Copilot CLI: Use new API to get session metadata * #4852: Use type-only imports from '@github/copilot/sdk' * #4853: Copilot CLI: Remove CopilotCLISessionOptions * #4847: Remove unused session tracking methods and related calls in CopilotCLISessionService * #4851: Copilot CLI: Fix nested sub agent calls * #4834: Fix toolTokens over-counting when Anthropic Tool Search is enabled * #4809: Update github copilot npm package * #4844: Add workspace metadata (git branch, commit, remote, file path) to OTel events and GH telemetry * #4839: Fix whitespace-only text block from orphaned CacheBreakpoint * #4835: Agent Debug: max session logs to retain * #4827: Use one WebSocket per conversation * #4788: Disable Claude co-attribution in commits/PRs * #4831: Clear workspace changes before retrieving modified files in FolderRepositoryManager * #4832: add prompting for HiddenFamilyH * #4828: Copilot CLI Controller API * #4833: Sessions - adopt new context key * #4830: Fix skill directory access * #4806: Clean up conversation store entries when chat sessions are disposed * #2660: Bump the all group across 1 directory with 4 updates * #4820: Use selected model when starting Copilot coding agent task * #4810: Add new CAPI standard header for assignment context * #4825: Sessions - limit when we show the discard changes action * #4304: Allow invoking simulationMain with alternative action input * #4786: Bump brace-expansion from 1.1.12 to 1.1.13 * #4822: chore: skip nuget MCP tests until less flaky * #4821: Sessions - prefer upstream for the base branch when present * #4817: Background - clean-up log statements * #4816: Background - do not stage changes for folder sessions * #4815: Bump version * #4785: Attach response output message IDs only to phased assistant messages This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=426216&view=logs).
